## Design decisions

- **Nothing folded silently.** The DF-S2.3-1 / DF-S1.15-3 residuals
  could have stayed parked on their (now-closed) owner rows; minting
  BL-44/BL-45 keeps the checker's exactly-once invariant honest and gives
  GATE-G4 named handles.
- **R-2.2.1 stays a register obligation.** Its residual is the OQ-388
  closed-sum ratification — a spec-ruling cell on BL-30/ADR-0274, not a
  requirement leg; the matrix row it sat on is discharged while the
  ruling stays owed.
- **Append-only throughout.** DEFERRALS gains one dated in-cell marker
  (BL-46 assignment); registers gain dated sections; no historical cell
  rewritten. The edit-tool stale-view standing rule (BL-41) was honoured
  — every write went through python/shell with `git diff` verification.
